decisions.reason: As a low-cost extension of the core dumper business with shared engineering, sales and service, it remains worth keeping on the market despite limited public evidence after two years.

This articulated dumper still fits the firm's established construction equipment range, so in a growing market management would usually give it more time unless internal results were clearly disappointing.

The underground mine rescue vehicle serves a narrower and more uncertain niche farther from the core range, but with long mining sales cycles and no explicit negative signal the option is still worth preserving for now.
The reported large order and strong rental-market acceptance substantially reduce uncertainty, so this close-to-core product line should clearly be retained.

Very heavy use within seven months provides strong early proof of customer value for this underground loader, making continued support the sensible option despite its greater distance from the established range.
